instruction: put the bowl on the stove
prompt: A video recorded from a robot's point of view executing the following instruction: put the bowl on the stove

input.observations: fixed replay; no physical robot actuation

measurement_notes.clock: All request and replan durations use this client's perf_counter only.
measurement_notes.topology: cloud -> client -> edge relay; payload crosses two HTTP legs.
measurement_notes.request_ms: From dispatch until complete response body; includes upload, HTTP, server queue/host/GPU work and response download.
measurement_notes.response_headers_wait_ms: Dispatch until response headers; not upload-only or TTFB.
measurement_notes.response_download_ms: Time reading response body after headers were exposed to requests; buffered/previously arrived bytes are included. Not pure network time or a one-way latency.
measurement_notes.payload_server_install_ms: Edge X-Recv-Done minus X-Recv-Start (same server clock): queue, unpack, H2D and installation; starts after body reception.
measurement_notes.payload_request_residual_ms: Payload request duration minus server install interval; includes bidirectional network and other HTTP/server overhead. Not a one-way network latency.
measurement_notes.body_bytes: Application HTTP body only, including LBC1 framing; excludes HTTP/TCP/IP headers.
measurement_notes.gpu_compute_ms: Server CUDA-event substeps; excludes other host/server work.
measurement_notes.capacity: Successful chunks / measured batch elapsed, including failed attempt time; warmup and one-time prompt/session/cache preparation excluded.
measurement_notes.actions: Each step generates 32 actions by default; deployment consumes 10 before replanning. Neither action rate is measured robot control frequency.
measurement_notes.warmup: Warmup batch uses the selected schedule, drains fully, then measured batch starts.
measurement_notes.stages: full=cloud+payload+step; cloud=encode only; payload=repeated install of fixed precomputed payload; edge=step only with fixed preinstalled cache.
measurement_notes.concurrency: One stream; pipeline has one cloud lookahead and serial edge calls. Not multi-session or open-loop saturation capacity.

deprecated_metrics.cloud_uplink_ms: Invalid cross-host perf_counter subtraction; not measured.
deprecated_metrics.edge_uplink_ms: Invalid cross-host perf_counter subtraction; not measured.
deprecated_metrics.z_transfer_ms: Old payload HTTP duration minus pooled RTT included installation and omitted the cloud response leg. No one-way transfer is measured.
deprecated_metrics.rtt_baseline_ms: Pooled cloud/edge RTT replaced by per-endpoint RTT samples.
